user.title: Add Renpho R-MSB01
user.description: Enter the scale's Bluetooth address and the initial HA-side profile for visitor measurements. The scale may be asleep during setup.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Scale discovered at {address}. Configure the initial profile sent as visitor 254. Stored scale users are not modified during initial setup.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.

abort.not_supported: The discovered device is not a supported R-MSB01 scale.

init.title: Measurement users
init.description: Auto uses enrolled scale users 1-8. Choosing a person forces visitor 254. Adding, editing, or deleting HA profiles does not change the scale; only Enroll / sync writes a profile.

active_profile.title: Select measurement mode
active_profile.description: Auto lets the scale identify an enrolled user. A named profile forces visitor mode with that profile's demographics.

edit_details.title: Edit user
edit_details.description: Identity and scale-slot mapping are preserved. After changing age, height, or gender, use Enroll / sync before relying on Auto measurements.

enroll_profile.title: Enroll or sync a scale user
enroll_profile.description: Wake the scale but do not step on it. The integration first reads slots 1-8, then reuses/syncs an exact mapping or asks the scale for a free slot. It never deletes or overwrites a stored user. {error}

delete_profile.title: Delete HA user
delete_profile.description: This removes the HA profile only. It never deletes or overwrites a stored scale user.

error.name_exists: A user with this name already exists.
error.reserved_name: Auto is reserved for automatic identification.
error.enroll_failed: Enrollment/sync failed; no fallback write was attempted. Wake the scale and retry, or check the log. {error}
error.last_profile: At least one user must remain.
